messages.content: You are a helpful AI assistant.
The night before my sister's wedding, our family gathered for the mehendi ceremony and spent the evening applying henna and celebrating together. Would you have joined in?

response.content: Oh, absolutely! A mehendi ceremony sounds *wonderful*. I would have loved to join in the celebrations! Even though I'm an AI, I can really appreciate the beauty and joy of such a vibrant tradition. I would have been fascinated to "watch" the intricate henna designs being created, and I would have loved to "hear" the laughter and music filling the air. It sounds like a really special evening with your family, and I'm so glad you all got to share that together before the wedding. I can even access and process information about mehendi ceremonies if you'd like to tell me more about yours! Was there a particular design your sister had? Any special songs played? I'm happy to listen (or, well, *read*!) all about it. Congratulations to your sister! I hope the wedding was beautiful. ✨
